ns2:course.label: Graduate Level Guitar
ns2:course.description: Study at the graduate level in guitar; selected studies from the masterworks in guitar literature. Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the String faculty. 2 to 5 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in separate semesters to a maximum of 20 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the String faculty.
